run_distributed_training: run the distributed training module spawning multiple GPU processes with automatic device detection
run_work_function: run the work function to execute a single worker process with rank and world size set
run_with_args_dict: run the distributed module by passing a dictionary of arguments instead of an Args object
run_with_strace: run the distributed module with strace monitoring enabled to log system calls for each process
run_with_auto_requeue: run the distributed module with auto requeue support to forward USR1 and TERM signals to child processes
